simple.meaning: עָשַׂר (ʻâsar) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to tithe , i.e. to take or give a tenth.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 9 times across Genesis, Deuteronomy, 1 Samuel, Nehemiah, beginning at Genesis 28:22. Its contexts include family, family line, flock, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָשַׂר (H6237).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עָשַׂר (ʻâsar) / H6237 is traced through Genesis 28:22, Deuteronomy 14:22, Deuteronomy 26:12, 1 Samuel 8:15 as a generated source-based concept entry.

structuredEvidence.definition: to tithe , i.e. to take or give a tenth

firstOccurrence.englishText: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you.”

majorEvents.label: Offering
majorEvents.evidenceText: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the wave offering of the grain, of the new wine, and of the oil, to the rooms, where the vessels of the sanctuary are, and the priests who minister, with the gatekeepers and the singers. We will not forsake the house of our God.

You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year.
You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year.

When you have finished tithing all the tithe of your increase in the third year, which is the year of tithing, then you shall give it to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, that they may eat within your gates and be filled.
He will take one tenth of your seed, and of your vineyards, and give it to his officers, and to his servants.
He will take one tenth of your flocks; and you will be his servants.
The priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes. The Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes to the house of our God, to the rooms, into the treasure house.

For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the wave offering of the grain, of the new wine, and of the oil, to the rooms, where the vessels of the sanctuary are, and the priests who minister, with the gatekeepers and the singers. We will not forsake the house of our God.

definitions.short: to tithe , i.e. to take or give a tenth
definitions.usage: × surely, give (take) the tenth, (have, take) tithe(-ing, -s), × truly.
definitions.full: H6237. asar [ עָשַׂר ] verb denominative take the tenth of, tithe ; — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular יַעְשׂר 1Sam 8:15 , 17 (with accusative of thing tithed). Pi`el Imperfect + Infinitive absolute give a tenth of , with accusative of thing: 2 masculine singular תְּעַשֵּׂר עַשֵּׂר Deut 14:22 ; 1 singular לָ֑ח אֲעַשְּׂרֶנּוּ עַשֵּׂר Gen 28:22 (P); Participle taking the tenth , הַמְעַשְּׂרִים Neh 10:38 . Hiph`il (so usually explained) Infinitive לַעְשֵׂר Deut 26:12 with accusative of congnate meaning with verb i.e. taking, reckoning, tithe , but Infinitive construct with ֵ֯ improbable, < read לְעַשֵּׂר Pi`el ; בַּעְשֵׂר Neh 10:39 absolute, i.e. receiving tithes , but read probably בַּעְשׂר Qal (on anomalous points, see Ges § 53k Dr Deut 26:12 ).
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root (identical with 6238 ); to accumulate; but used only as denominative from 6235 ;
